risks.proof: Photos of the serial number, any labels or stickers indicating import status, or a certificate of authenticity.

risks.risk: Machine may have been damaged in transit or has cosmetic damage not visible in photo 0
risks.proof: Photos of all sides, including the back, bottom, and any ports or connections.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and operating.
Photos of the serial number and any labels or stickers.
Photos of the back, bottom, and all sides of the machine.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Miller XMT 350 CC/CV welding machine. The seller's claim of 'direct Belgium' is contradicted by the U.S. origin label. The machine can be priced at its worst case (as not working) until proof of functionality is provided. Hidden risks include non-functionality and cosmetic damage, which can be resolved with additional photos and a video.
